title: Episode 17: The Texas Archives War: How Mrs. Eberly Fired a Six-Pound Cannon in Austin
description: In December 1842, Texas President Sam Houston sent a secret military detachment to sneak the national archives out of Austin at midnight. Boarding house owner Angelina Eberly spotted the wagons, ran to Congress Avenue, and fired a loaded six-pound town defense cannon directly into the Land Office, mobilizing the citizens to preserve Austin as the permanent capital of Texas.
